image_description: A close-up view of a metallic breastplate armor displayed on a mannequin or stand. The armor features a polished silver/steel finish with decorative brass or bronze rivets arranged in rows across the chest and abdomen. The plate has anatomical contouring with a raised central ridge and segmented lower sections (faulds) for mobility. Leather straps are visible at the side, connecting the front plate to the back. The background is blurred, suggesting an indoor museum or display setting.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like cuirass or plastron.
To analyze the realism of the reflections and metal texture, checking for AI-generated smoothing or noise artifacts.
To verify the sharpness of the armor edges against the background and ensure no melting or boundary bleeding.
To assess the 3D depth of the embossed rivets and the curvature of the plate relative to the background.

focus_areas: Reflectivity and specular highlights on metal surface
Structural integrity of rivets and attachment points
Edge sharpness between armor and background
Anatomical correctness of the armor's curvature
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflection patterns on the metal surface; AI often struggles with complex environmental reflections on curved metallic objects. Verify if the rivets appear physically attached or merely painted on. Check for any subtle warping in the straight lines of the background which might indicate lens distortion or AI generation artifacts.
